cases.note: The changed explicit integer pattern for the Core schema dropped the optional sign before the octal alternative (`[-+]?0o` became `[-+]0o`), so any explicitly tagged octal integer without a sign, e.g. `!!int 0o10`, no longer resolves and load() throws. (The hypothesis's '+0o10' case is still rejected by both builds since '[-+]0o' requires the sign but '[-+]?0x...' order doesn't help; the actual regression is the signless octal form.)
